rules.statement: A court has the power to vacate proceedings and grant a fresh adjudication when a party was unable to attend due to illness, provided they had retained a proctor and there is no evidence of deliberate delay.
rules.supporting_quote: "The petitioner explains her default at the trial has been due to her serious ailment about that period and on her recovery it was that she made this application to this Court to have the proceedings of the trial vacated and to permit her an opportunity of proving her claim."

meta.parties: Waseela Umma v. Sally Et Al
